title: Substitution Between Corporate Social Responsibility Activities: Evidence from Hiring and Mistreating Unauthorized Workers and Pollution
authors: Ying Huang; Ningzhong Li; Xiaolu Zhou
eligible_reason: Table 4 columns 1-2 regress log(1+toxic release) at the facility-chemical-year level on a single binary E-Verify indicator (ev0 = universal or public mandate in force in the plant's state) with facility-chemical FE and chemical-by-year FE (column 2 adds 5-digit-NAICS-by-year FE), no controls, clustered by state. 23 states adopt in 9 distinct years (2006-2015) and 33 states never adopt. Table 11 Panel B reports Callaway-Sant'Anna (csdid) estimates of the same design on three samples. Table 11 Panel C column 1 repeats the TWFE with parent-by-year FE and no controls. Columns using ev1 and ev2 jointly (two mandate types as separate regressors), event studies that add the other mandate as a regressor, Table 10 (controls), and Table 11 Panel A (stacked cohort samples) are excluded.
design_notes: Panel: TRI facility x chemical x year, 2000-2018 (law-passage years deleted), main.dta has 1,378,122 rows, 169,932 facility-chemical units, 39,063 facilities, 56 state codes. Treatment construction (1. sas code.sas lines 37-83; 2. stata code.do lines 24-25): event = state E-Verify law passage year (AL 2011, AZ 2007, CO 2006, FL 2011, GA 2011, ID 2009, IN 2011, LA 2011, MI 2012, MN 2011, MO 2008, MS 2008, NC 2011, NE 2009, OK 2007, PA 2012, SC 2011, TN 2011, TX 2014, UT 2010, VA 2010, WV 2012; RI public mandate 2008-2010 hand-coded); ev1 = 1 for universal-mandate states (ev_pvt) in years after passage; ev2 = 1 for public-mandate states (ev_pub) in years after passage, plus earlier public-mandate years for NC, GA (2006-2010), SC (2008-2010), UT (2008-2009) and RI (2008-2010); ev0 = ev1 | ev2. In the data ev0 first switches on by state in 2006 (GA, NC), 2007 (CO), 2008 (AZ, UT, SC, OK), 2009 (MS, RI, MO), 2010 (ID, NE), 2011 (VA), 2012 (TN, AL, LA, IN, FL, MN), 2013 (PA, MI, WV), 2015 (TX); ev0 is monotone except RI, where it switches off after 2010 (protocol rule: drop RI post-2010 rows). ev2 switches off when a universal mandate replaces a public one (GA, NC, SC, UT), so ev1 and ev2 are mutually exclusive categories. Outcome y1 = log(1+tri_all). FE: frs_cas = group(trifd cas) unit FE; cas_yr = group(cas cyear) chemical-by-year FE (chemical is part of the unit definition, so time-invariant); ind_yr = group(na5 cyear) 5-digit NAICS by year (na5 varies within facility for 5,328 of 39,063 facilities, so this FE is not strictly time-invariant-by-time; flagged as a caveat); prnt_yr = group(parent cyear) in main_robust.dta (parent varies within 211 facilities). vce(cluster state). No weights. csdid files: csdid_all_pub.dta (both mandate types, gvar=event with cohorts 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2014 and 73,961 never-treated units out of 169,868), csdid_all.dta (universal mandate only: cohorts 2007, 2008, 2010, 2011), csdid_pub.dta (public mandate only: cohorts 2006-2014); each csdid call is followed by estat simple. Note the csdid gvar equals the passage year while the TWFE indicators switch on the year after passage (passage year deleted).
estimators_reported: twfe_event_study (reghdfe with e_4..e5 leads/lags, one mandate type at a time with the other mandate indicator as control)
main_or_robustness: main (Table 4 is the main test; csdid in Table 11 Panel B is robustness)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 9 distinct first-adoption years for ev0 in the TWFE sample (2006-2015); 8 cohorts in csdid_all_pub (gvar = passage year 2006-2014); 4 cohorts in csdid_all (universal mandates).

specs.treatment_definition: state has a universal or public E-Verify mandate in force (years after passage year; passage year dropped)
specs.unit_var: frs_cas = group(trifd cas) (facility x chemical); assignment unit state
specs.sample_condition: all rows of main.dta (RI post-2010 switch-off to be dropped per protocol)

specs.fe: frs_cas; cas_yr; ind_yr (= group(na5 cyear), 5-digit NAICS by year)
specs.notes: caveat: na5 changes over time for about 14% of facilities, so the NAICS-by-year FE is not purely a time-invariant characteristic interacted with time

specs.treatment_var: gvar event (passage year of the first universal or public mandate; 0 = never treated)
specs.fe: csdid (unit and time, long differences); estat simple aggregate
specs.notes: TWFE counterpart is T4_c1_ev0 up to the passage-year timing convention

specs.treatment_var: gvar event (universal-mandate passage year; 0 = never treated)
specs.sample_condition: csdid_all.dta (863,389 rows; universal-mandate states and never-treated; cohorts 2007, 2008, 2010, 2011)

specs.treatment_var: gvar event (public-mandate passage year; 0 = never treated)
specs.sample_condition: csdid_pub.dta (1,106,023 rows; public-mandate states and never-treated; cohorts 2006-2014)

specs.fe: frs_cas; cas_yr; ind_yr; prnt_yr (= group(parent cyear))
specs.notes: robustness; same NAICS caveat plus parent changes for 211 facilities

specs.exclusion_reason: two treatment regressors (ev1 universal mandate, ev2 public mandate) in the same regression
specs.reported_location: Table 4 columns 3-4; same structure in Tables 6, 7 (subsamples), 9 (abatement/production outcomes) and 8 (OSHA violations, estab_n + sic2-by-year FE)
specs.notes: could be re-cast as two separate single-treatment designs but is not reported that way

specs.exclusion_reason: event study of one mandate type with the other mandate indicator as an additional treatment regressor (ev2 in Panel A, ev1 in Panel B)
specs.treatment_var: e_4 e_3 e_2 e_1 e_0 e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 (relative to event) plus ev2
specs.notes: Panel B re-codes RI (event 2008, ev_pub 1, e3-e5 zeroed after 2010)

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked cohort design (event x unit FE, event x chemical x year FE)
specs.treatment_var: ev3 (either mandate) in cross3.dta; ev1 ev2 in cross1.dta and cross2.dta

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying firm and state controls (lmv mb1 roa1 ppe stdroa1 div runem pop_chg gdp; or runem pop_chg gdp dem lcv) and/or two treatment regressors
specs.outcome: fc_ww fc_kz fc_sa mbt1 mbt2 mbt3 (Table 10); y1 (Table 11 Panel C columns 2-4)

data_access: public (EPA TRI, OSHA, IPUMS, Census/BLS; Compustat/IBES only for Table 10). All final analysis datasets are shipped in data/.
data_files: data/t4.csv ... t11c.csv (author output tables, useful for checking replicated coefficients)
software: stata (reghdfe 5.7.3, csdid 1.72); SAS 9.4 for data construction
screener_notes: Article text not available; column numbering inferred from the do-file comments and the shipped t4.csv/t11b.csv/t11c.csv output files, which should be used to confirm the published coefficients. Decisions to confirm with the lead: (1) whether chemical-by-year FE (chemical is a component of the unit id) and NAICS-by-year FE with occasional NAICS changes count as allowed time-invariant-by-time FE; (2) RI switch-off after 2010 handled by dropping those rows; (3) the three csdid samples use passage year as gvar while the TWFE ev0 switches on the following year (passage year deleted), so the TWFE counterpart for the csdid specs should be built from the csdid files themselves.
